Italian-native Ada Rovatti is making her mark in the jazz scene as a saxophonist, producer, composer, and band leader. Her recent “Sacred Bond”
release features her husband, Randy Brecker, performing Ada’s original compositions.
Ada was interviewed via Zoom on December 13, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m at Hamilton College for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m really pleased to have Ada Rovatti with me this afternoon. Welcome.
Well thank you. Thank you for having me.
I’m going to ask you a new question for today. So far today on this Tuesday, what have you done musically that contributes to you making a living in music?
